returned transaction pointer is stored at wrapper +0x04, then result-preparation helper called

CTransactionID constructor, CList<CTransactionID>, StartTransaction, and DeleteAll are present and cross-referenced; direct insertion instruction for this specific ReadVarAsync instance is not in the captured slice
WaitComplete/Free and list/destructor machinery are present; no static instruction proving lookup keyed by generated ReqID was identified
downstream helper writes generated/result value through an output pointer; this is distinct from starter +0x98 pointer storage
indirect calls exist at callback interface vtable +0x14 and transaction-object vtable +0x04
allocation failure path sets HRESULT 0x80004004 and clears +0x08; diagnostic is 'Com-Object released or Async-Transaction cancelled'
CTransactionID::WaitComplete returns CResult or null based on state; Free, CloseUp, Delete, destructor, and list DeleteAll provide release/teardown operations

non_conflations: pReqID pointer at transaction +0x98 != generated ReqID numeric value
wrapper +0x04 transaction pointer != caller pReqID pointer
RID format/logging use != proof of generator
indirect vtable dispatch != proof of ReadVarAsync callback method or thread
